Method of Attack: Streaming and providing illegal downloads of copyrighted music
Discoverer: U.S. Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) and the Department of Justice in cooperation with Brazilian authorities
Impacted Systems: Websites streaming and providing unauthorized copyrighted music content
Attack Vector: Websites registered with US-based registrars, advertised on social media
Indicators of Compromise: Sites seized and displaying federal government seizure message; 15 social network profiles used for promotion also taken down
